summary: Decision prompt lets an agent ask a few multiple-choice questions before it starts a task, one question at a time. When the last one is answered it shows a short summary of the choices and a line that says the agent is getting going.
use: When a request is vague and two or three answers would change what the agent does.
When you want quick answers by keyboard instead of a long reply in chat.
When some questions can be left to the agent and people should be able to skip them.
When the person should see a recap of their choices before the work begins.
features: Shows one question at a time with a "Question 2 of 3" counter and progress dots.
Each option shows a number badge, its `label` and an optional `detail` such as "Recommended".
Continue saves the picked option and moves on. Skip records `null`, which the summary shows as `skippedLabel` ("Agent decides" by default).
Double-clicking an option picks it and continues in one go.
`onComplete` fires with every answer once the last question is done. Answers can also be controlled with `answers` and `onAnswersChange`.
The summary ends with a `startLabel` line that shimmers until you set `started`, then settles with a check and `startedLabel`.
a11y: Options sit in a `radiogroup` labelled with the question, and each option is a `radio` with `aria-checked`.
Number keys 1 to 9 pick an option, Arrow Up and Arrow Down move the choice, and Enter continues.
The question area is an `aria-live="polite"` region, so each new question and the summary are announced.
Once all questions are answered the Skip and Continue footer is made `inert`.

faq.q: How do I get the answers to my agent?
faq.a: Use `onComplete`. It receives an array with the chosen option's index for each question, or `null` where the person skipped.

faq.q: Does the keyboard work right away?
faq.a: The whole prompt is focusable, so the keys work once it has focus, for example after clicking an option. Number keys pick, arrows move and Enter continues.

faq.q: How do I show that the agent has actually started?
faq.a: Set `started` to true. The shimmering `startLabel` line turns into a check with `startedLabel`, or the same text if you leave that out.
